# cloudflare_zero_trust_casb_webhook (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `Zero Trust Read`
- `Zero Trust Write`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)
- `authentication_type` (String) Type of authentication used for the webhook.
Available values: "Basic Auth", "None", "Bearer Auth", "Static Headers", "HMAC-Signing".
- `destination_url` (String) Target URL for the webhook configuration. Where resulting data will be sent.
- `label` (String) Account-specified display label for the webhook configuration.

### Optional

- `headers` (Attributes List) List of custom headers to include in webhook requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret key used for HMAC signing when authentication_type is "HMAC-Signing".
- `status` (String) Status of the webhook configuration. Defaults to enabled when omitted.
Available values: "enabled", "disabled".

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook configuration was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the specific webhook configuration.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook configuration was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Version number of the configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Required:

- `key` (String) Header key name.

Optional:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Header value. Required on Create and Evaluate. On Update, omit or set to null to keep existing value.
